title: l-adic representations of a profinite group (Weil II (1.1.6))
statement:
Let $\pi$ be a profinite group, $\ell$ a prime, $\Qlb$ an algebraic closure of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure], and for $E$ in the directed set $\mathcal E_\ell$ of finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ in $\Qlb$ [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set] let $\mathcal O_E$, $\mathfrak m_E$ be as in [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], $E$ with its $\ell$-adic topology.

1. A *continuous $\mathcal O_E$-representation* of $\pi$ is a finitely generated $\mathcal O_E$-module $M$ with an action of $\pi$ by $\mathcal O_E$-linear automorphisms such that $\pi\times M\to M$ is continuous for the $\mathfrak m_E$-adic topology of $M$; morphisms are $\pi$-equivariant $\mathcal O_E$-linear maps.
2. A *continuous $E$-representation* of $\pi$ is a finite-dimensional $E$-vector space $V$ with an action of $\pi$ by $E$-linear automorphisms such that $\pi\times V\to V$ is continuous for the $\ell$-adic topology of $V$; morphisms are equivariant $E$-linear maps. Tensor products carry the diagonal action; the unit is $E$ with trivial action. For $E\subset L$, $V\mapsto V\otimes_EL$ with action $\sigma\otimes1$.
3. An *$\ell$-adic representation* of $\pi$ on a finite-dimensional $\Qlb$-vector space $V$ is a homomorphism $\sigma:\pi\to\operatorname{GL}(V)$ for which there are $E\in\mathcal E_\ell$ and an $E$-structure $V_E\subset V$ (an $E$-subspace with $V_E\otimes_E\Qlb\xrightarrow{\sim}V$) stable under $\sigma(\pi)$ such that $\pi\to\operatorname{GL}(V_E)$ is a continuous $E$-representation. Morphisms are $\pi$-equivariant $\Qlb$-linear maps; tensor products carry the diagonal action.
